comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (40.38%) to Tachystatin C. R: 19%; L=G: 11%. Discovery: Host expression:induced in hemolymph and gill upon infection, binding to LPS, DNA, and chitin Activity: inhibited the growth of Gram+ S. aureus, S. agalactiae, Gram- A. hydrophila, K. pneumoniae (MIC ?). Animal model: zebrafish: Survival: i.p. administration of Tatritin (24 h ahead) reduced the mortality of zebrafish (88.3% in 7 days) infected with A. hydrophila. Recombinant production:yeast:Pichia pastoris: expression and purification via afficity column. The purified His-tagged peptide showed activity against E. coli (MIC 125 ug/ml), A. hydrophila (MIC 31 ug/ml), S. agalactiae (MIC 15.6 ug/ml), S. aureus (MIC 62 ug/ml), and K. pneumoniae (MIC 62 ug/ml). Animal model:fish: survival: 28-day feeding of the recombinant peptide reduced the mortalities of grass carps (84%) compared with negative controls (46%) ( Wang et al., 2023).
title: Identification of a Novel Antimicrobial Peptide From the Ancient Marine Arthropod Chinese Horseshoe Crab, Tachypleus tridentatus.
